introBody: XUGA is a small, student-led island-wear brand in Malta. A real person reads every message. Whether you want a piece, have a question, or just want to say something kind, we would love to hear it.

channels.label: Instagram
channels.note: New pieces, the fastest way to ask what is in stock, and where we will be next.

channels.label: Email
channels.note: For commissions, longer questions, or sending us a towel with a story.

channels.label: At the markets
channels.note: We sell in person at island markets. Watch Instagram for the next date and stall.

commissionEyebrow: Got a towel with a story?
commissionHeading: We will turn it into something you keep.
commissionBody: Send us the towel from a childhood summer, an old hotel, a holiday you still think about. We will sew it into a piece and write its tale, so the memory comes with it.
